newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate closes sharply down, liquid mkt.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate closes sharply down, liquid mkt.

text.p: Mexico's overnight Cetes rate closed down 200 basis points at 28.20 percent on Wednesday in what traders said was a liquid market.
Some dealers said big players deliberately flooded the market with liquidity to force down interest rates.
"Although overnight rates were lower than for many recent sessions, dealing was light. They brought rates down to a floor level and then they stayed there," one dealer said.
Other traders said the fall in rates was due to Tuesday's Federal Open Market Committee meeting decision not to change U.S. interest rates.
Overnight rates on bank paper meanwhile closed down 70 basis points at 29.90 percent.
Banco de Mexico offset liquidity shortages by injecting 6.006 billion pesos through four credit auctions, which it assigned at between 29.75 percent and 29.86 percent.
Total credit maturities for Thursday were estimated at 2.496 billion pesos.
